observable_requests.affirmative_interpretation: The carrier shape agrees with itself under a half-turn about its center, with corresponding opposite sides, arcs, lobes, or notches.

panel_descriptions.neg_0: A narrow three-stroke spike with a tall apex, a short inner junction, and uneven lower arms.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: An hourglass-like network with a zigzag left edge, a square-marked right edge, two central triangle chains, and an extra upper-right branch.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: A pointed leaf-shaped loop attached at one end to diverging chains of circles and triangles.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: A twisted wrapper-like closed outline with unequal triangular ends and an offset curved waist.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: A branching two-lobed network with a long zigzag left stem, a circular right boundary, and an inner diagonal chain of triangles.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: A lopsided leaf-or-rocket outline with an upper-right point and a deep lower-left cleft.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: A roughly oval closed carrier whose opposite arcs balance around the center, decorated in sectors with squares, triangles, and dense wavy marks.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: A slanted parallelogram carrier with square-marked opposite upright sides, a solid upper diagonal, and a circle-marked lower diagonal.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: A small skewed parallelogram carrier assembled from a solid diagonal, circular chains, and a dense wavy side.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: A slanted parallelogram carrier with square marks below, triangular marks on both side portions, and a dense wavy upper edge.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A closed N-like contour with two opposed rounded lobes and two opposed inward notches arranged around its center.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: An elongated parallelogram carrier with opposed horizontal segments and two opposed slanting chains of squares and triangles.

model_payload.positive_description: Each positive panel has a carrier shape with half-turn symmetry: rotating its overall organization by 180 degrees aligns corresponding opposite structure.
